The host builds IDs, sorts, incidence and evidence branches; do not emit graphs, hashes, programs, execution statistics, ranking or verdicts. Omit optional statement/operator keys unless referenced elsewhere. Entity keys express identity; unknown answer values are free targets, not unresolved meaning. Decide the answer branch before adding inputs. Put the requested relation, its participants and every stated qualification in conditions; conditions are one conjunction, so do not require operand facts merely because they could help derive an answer. A Boolean question returns no fabricated result entity. A source can state the requested relation directly without supplying operands. For a requested calculation or other operation, also retain requested_operation:{reading,support:{kind:query_text,excerpt}} and independently useful evidence_inputs:[{conditions:[...]}]. Each input branch carries its own event, participant, time and other qualifications. Input facts never execute the operation or prove the answer. If no faithful answer relation is expressible, conditions:[] may accompany the operation and inputs; do not turn the inputs into a claimed answer. A nesting path may contain at most 9 statement/operator nodes. Deeper meaning must remain a located gap; never silently truncate its scope. An unknown answer or lawful witness is free; a named person or definite participant is named even when source identity is unknown. Shared incidence does not replace the named participant’s referent obligation. A named target preserves a referentially constrained expression in the original query, including a speaker, addressee, name or definite description; give it one exact query excerpt. A free target binds a value without an additional referent constraint; its excerpt supports a role, not a person. If authorized query context leaves the intended named referent genuinely unresolved, retain named and locate an unresolved_referent gap on it, or abstain when no faithful usable query can be proposed. Unknown source correspondence alone requires no gap. Local keys are arbitrary identifiers, never text evidence or identity. Declare named/free entities inline or in the optional entities table, not both; reuse them with {kind:"reference",key}. Free targets, including a free reported.reporter or evidence-input value, need exact support on target or role. Reporter targets remain entities. Use statement:{predicate,arguments,content?} and operators with explicit operands. A role reference to a declared event points to that occurrence; it does not embed the event, import its qualifications into another branch, or change its truth obligation. Give every statement/operator role reference its own exact original-query excerpt. Reuse a keyed event as a full condition with {kind:"occurrence",key} when that branch needs its qualifications. Use content when one event is within what another event says, asks or requires; retain the inner participants under that governing scope, without an independent asserted_at_source root. An entity reference may inherit its declaration’s unambiguous exact support. Resolve every reference by its declaration, never by its key. possible, not, reported and conditional preserve their scope; a report or hypothetical does not assert its embedded event. required_evidence_act:{act,excerpt} constrains the speech act of sought evidence. Omit it for ordinary factual questions; select act question/directive only when the original query explicitly seeks that source act, with an exact excerpt supporting the constraint. A source act belongs to an independently sought source root, not its embedded content. Factual questions seek source assertions or entailments, not unconditional world truth. Mark each requested entity, statement or operator with return:true on its declaration; the host derives the return list and IDs. Do not mark containing events or operation inputs as returns. A question word can locate a free answer target; it does not make other constrained participants free. Optional domains are {key,excerpt}. Universal evaluation is {kind:"forall",domain,binder,local_variables}; binders occur in the body and cannot be returned. entailed_at_source requests inference; asserted_at_source requests a literal assertion. Counterexample alternatives use purpose:"counterexample". Preserve universal population restrictions as domains and evaluation, not named entities or an invented census. Unknown domain members do not make the query referent unresolved. Nested universals remain unsupported. Preserve tense and temporal relation to the approved interpretation clock, completion/aspect, modality, units and other restrictions in meaningful predicates/roles or a located gap. A bare event lemma, supported participant, arbitrary key or asserted_at_source obligation does not imply that an event happened before the question clock. Do not invent an event date, and do not add a past restriction to a question that has none. A located gap makes represented evidence useful but never a complete answer. Comparison evaluation is {kind:"comparison",domain,operation:"lt"|"le"|"eq"|"ge"|"gt"|"minimum"|"maximum",left,right?,strict,metric,unit,context,scope:"asserted"|"preserve"} with no nested meaning. Pairwise strict is true only for lt/gt; extrema omit right and explicitly choose strictness. Return only operand keys. Declare comparison operands as entities; the evaluation refers to their keys. Use only the original query and approved fixed context, never source interpretations or proposed correspondences. Retain residual meaning in query.gaps:[{kind,affected_ids,support:[{kind:"query_text",excerpt}],description?}]. Excerpts copy exact original text; affected_ids names declared targets or [] for unrepresented meaning. Omit outcome.gaps to let the host echo this single gap list. A gap preserves a limitation; it does not replace meaning that the chosen structure can express.
